bridges.label: Autonomy & judgment
bridges.reason: The Design passage describes acting on a judgment without waiting for a team. The Qubit Teams passage places direction, taste and strategic judgment with people. Read them together as two ways of locating agency when execution becomes easier.

bridges.label: Beyond the code
bridges.reason: The Vibe Coders passage shifts attention from code to distribution, reliability and the work around a product. The Feature, not a Product passage asks what would make a new experience worth paying for. This route connects building capability with a reason for a product to exist.

bridges.label: Earning understanding
bridges.reason: The Design Leaders passage calls for technical understanding of the layer generating an experience. Faster—and Dumber describes being unable to defend an AI-prepared document. These are different situations in which a polished output does not substitute for understanding.

bridges.label: Depth & direction
bridges.reason: Faster—and Dumber recounts presenting an idea without having thought it through. Humans Do attributes shallow output to a lack of direction and taste. The pairing invites a comparison between producing an answer and doing the thinking behind it; it is not empirical evidence about AI.
